مقدمة
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The Control & 
 Protection of HP bypass & Live steam consists of:
Release and Protection testing for HP bypass & Live steam system:
a- HP-bypass (Hydraulic) .
b- HP-bypass (Electrical) .
c- Live steam & Warm up valve for live steam.
For testing protection system perform the foالتدفق:
Each protection loop have (sensor, switch, software logic, I/O electronic 
 modules, and final control element test)
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. 
 Ashraf Ahmed, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Fekry Yousef, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 Al-Emam, accepted by eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed: general manager, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.
